r_0211.description: Goob ciyaareed oo bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay carruurta iyo qoysaska. Ciyaaraha miiska iyo ciyaaraha tayada leh oo la amaahiyo sannadlaha (20 CHF/sannadkii). Goobta la kulmada ee qoysaska xaafadda.

r_0212.description: Xarun nasasho oo loogu talagalay dhalinyarada 15-25 jir. Goob kayn ah oo leh hoolka isku-xirka, masrax, jiko, studio duubaab iyo moofada pizza. Soo dhaweyn xor ah, riwaayado, safarro, cunto wadaag iyo taageero mashruucyada dhalinyarada.

r_0213.description: Guriga xaafadda iyo Beer Robinson ee Châtelaine-Balexert. Goob wanaagsan oo la kulmo lana is weydaarsado xaafadda. Hawlaha dhaqanka iyo nasashada ee carruurta (6-12), dhallinyarada (12-18) iyo dadka waaweyn. Beer dabiici ah iyo xayawaan.
r_0213.access_conditions: Bilaash, qaar ka mid ah hawlaha diiwaangellin ayaa loo baahan yahay

r_0214.description: Swiss Pallia Confort: Hay'ad aan faa'iido doon ahayn oo bixisa raaxo iyo wehel aan caafimaad ahayn bukaanada ku dhow dhimasho ee guryahooda ama xarumaha daryeelka. Joogitaan habeenkii (12+ saacadood/maalintii), taageero nafsaani, jireed iyo ruuxaani. Taageero qoysaska daryeelka. Bilaash dadka dakhligoodu hooseeyo.
r_0214.target_audience: Bukaanada dhowaanshaha dhimasho ee doonaya inay guryahooda joogaan, qoysaska daryeelka
r_0214.access_conditions: Bilaash dadka dakhligoodu hooseeyo. Ka-qaybgal dhaqaale waa suurtogal. Nala soo xiriir iimayl.

r_0215.name: Chez Gilberte – guriga bulshada Meyrin
r_0215.description: Xarun bulshada uu maamulo magaalada Meyrin. Meel diiran oo furan oo dhan loogu soo dhawoow, ujeeddo la leeyahay ama la'aan. Dhageysi, is-dhaafsiga iyo kulan qoysaska carruurta da'da dugsiga kahor. Hawlaha waxbarashada, goobta ciyaarta iyo wadahadallka waalidnimada. Koox farsamo badan.
r_0215.target_audience: Qoysaska carruurta da'da dugsiga kahor, dadweynaha guud
r_0215.access_conditions: Bilaash ah oo u furan dhammaan dadka deggan Meyrin.

r_0216.name: Maktabadda Ciyaarta ee Meyrin
r_0216.description: Maktabad ciyaareed oo magaalada ah oo bixisa amaahda ciyaaraha bilaashka ah ama tijaabinta goobta. Xulashada ballaaran ee ciyaaraha miiska, ciyaaraha waxbarashada iyo ciyaaraha dibadda ee carruurta iyo dadka waaweyn. Bilaash oo dhan u furan.

r_0217.name: Maktabadda Forum Meyrin
r_0217.description: Maktabad magaalada ah oo u adeegta xarun macluumaad, dhaqan, kulan, waxbarasho iyo madadaalo. Diiwaangelin bilaash ah dadka ku nool ama ka shaqeeya Geneva. Amaahda buugaagta, CD, DVD. WiFi bilaash, goobaha shaqada, hawlaha carruurta iyo dadka waaweyn.
r_0217.access_conditions: Diiwaangelin bilaash ah dadka ku nool ama ka shaqeeya Canton Geneva.

r_0218.name: Baobab – La-talinta umulisadaha
r_0218.description: La-talin bilaash ah oo aan ballanqaad lahayn umulisadaha, khamis kasta galabnimo. Jawaabaha su'aalaha uurka, dhalmada, naas-nuujinta iyo daryeelka ilmaha cusub. Goob dhageysi iyo taageero waalidka mustaqbalka iyo qoysaska ilmaha yaryar leh.
r_0218.target_audience: Haweenka uurka leh, waalidka mustaqbalka, qoysaska ilmaha yaryar leh
r_0218.access_conditions: Bilaash oo aan ballanqaad lahayn. Khamiista furan marka laga reebo maalmaha fasaxa.

r_0219.name: Maison Vaudagne – xarunta madadaalada Meyrin
r_0219.description: Xarun bulshada iyo madadaalo oo taariikhi ah Meyrin (tan iyo 1964), ku xiran Hay'adda Geneva ee Dhaqdhaqaaqa Bulshada iyo Dhaqanka (FASe). Hawlaha bulsho-waxbarasho iyo dhaqan-bulshada carruurta (4-9 sano), dhallinyarada iyo dadka waaweyn. Hawlo, safarro Arbaco, xerada fasaxa. Koox xirfadlayaal iyo mutadawiciin ah.
r_0219.target_audience: Carruur (4-9 sano), dhallinyaro, qoysas, dadweynaha guud
r_0219.access_conditions: Bilaash oo dhan u furan. Mudnaanta carruurta Meyrin.

r_0220.name: Association La Farce - Dukaan bilaash oo ardayda
r_0220.description: Dukaan cunto bilaash oo ardayda jaamacadaha Geneva. Arbaco/Khamiis qaybinta. Talaado maqaaxi bilaash.

r_0221.name: BCAS - Adeeg bulshada (kaalmada dhaqaale)
r_0221.description: Xafiiska Dhexe ee Caawimada Bulshada Geneva. Kaalmada dhaqaale ee shaqaalaha dhibaatada.

r_0223.name: SOS Carruurta - La-talinta nafsi (BCAS)
r_0223.description: Adeeg bilaash ah oo taageerada nafsi carruurta iyo qoysaskooda.

r_0240.name: Creative Italian Workshops for Children (COMITES)
r_0240.description: Free creative Italian language and culture workshops for children aged 6–12, every Wednesday afternoon. Visual arts, performance, literature and technology. Open to all nationalities.

r_0241.name: Committee of Italians Abroad (COMITES) Geneva
r_0241.description: Representation body for the Italian community in Geneva. Administrative information, integration support, sociocultural opportunities. Free services.

r_0242.name: Point info Plainpalais (City of Geneva)
r_0242.description: Free municipal information and social orientation service. Support for administrative procedures. Open to all Geneva city residents.
r_0242.access_conditions: Free and open to all Geneva city residents.

r_0243.description: Free municipal information and social orientation service. Support for administrative procedures. Open to all Geneva city residents.
r_0243.access_conditions: Free and open to all Geneva city residents.

r_0244.name: Atelier Alpha
r_0244.description: Urur bixiya casharro Faransiis af iyo wax-akhriska dadka muhaajiriinta ah ee aan waxba akhriyin ama ku adagtahay barashada. Waxbarasho cusub oo awood-siinaya meel u diyaarsan. Casharro Isniin ilaa Jimce subax iyo galabnimo, casharro fiidkii Isniin iyo Arbaco. Qiimo u habaysan miisaaniyadaha yar: CHF 20/bishii dadka ka faa'iidaysanaya Hospice Général.
r_0244.target_audience: Muhaajiriin aan waxba akhriyin ama wax yar bartay
r_0244.access_conditions: CHF 20/bishii dadka Hospice Général (qiimaha caadiga ah CHF 205/bishii). Ugu yaraan 2 kulan/toddobaad.

r_0245.name: Goobta waalidiinta-carruurta Saint-Gervais
r_0245.description: Goob ciyaar iyo nasasho qoysas xaalad adag ku jira oo leh carruur da'doodu tahay 0-12 sano. Qado bilaash ah 12:15. Dhagaysi, aqoonsi iyo hagid bulsho oo ay sameeyaan koox xirfadlayaal ah. Fur shuruud la'aan iyo magac la'aan, fasaxyada iskuulka dhexdooda.
r_0245.target_audience: Qoysas xaalad adag ku jira oo leh carruur 0-12 sano, haweenka uurka leh
r_0245.access_conditions: Bilaash, shuruud la'aan, soo dhaweyn magac la'aan. Fur fasaxyada iskuulka (marka laga reebo hal bil xagaa). Xiran maalmaha ciidda.

r_0246.name: Goob biyo la cabbo — promenade de l'Aire (Confignon)
r_0246.description: Goob biyo la cabbo oo si xor ah loo heli karo oo ku taal jidka socodka ee promenade de l'Aire ee dib loo cusboonaysiiyay, agagaarka buundada passerelle des Chardons-à-Tête-Ronde. Goob nasasho oo leh kursi iyo miisas fasax (picnic). Waxaa la heli karaa 24 saac maalintii, sannadka oo dhan.

r_0247.name: Info seniors Lancy — Adeeg taleefan (Pôle seniors)
r_0247.description: Adeeg taleefan oo bilaash ah oo ay bixiso Magaalada Lancy oo loogu talagalay dadka waayeelka ah ee Lancy iyo qaraabadooda: adeegyada degmada, hawlo iyo socdaallo, mutadawacnimo, xulashooyinka guryaha waayeelka, u-gudbinta hay'adaha daryeelka iyo adeegyada taageerada guriga (cunto, nadiifin, dukaameysi, gaadiid) iyo gargaarka maaliyadeed ee kantoonka iyo federaalka.
r_0247.target_audience: Dadka Lancy degan ee gaaray da'da hawlgabnimada (AVS), qaraabadooda iyo dadka u dhow
r_0247.access_conditions: Bilaash, diiwaangelin la'aan. Lambar taleefan oo bilaash ah.

r_0248.name: Adeegga Caawimaada Dijitaalka ah ee Lancy (Villa Rapin)
r_0248.description: Laba jeer bishiiba, Adeegga Arrimaha Bulshada iyo Guryeynta ee Lancy wuxuu dadka degan kala caawiyaa qalabkooda dijitaalka ah (smartphone, kombuyuutar, tablet) iyo hawlaha maamulka ee internetka lagu qabto. Waxaa kormeera arday iyo xirfadlayaal. Isniin bishiiba mar 17:00–19:00 iyo Talaado bishiiba mar 14:00–16:00 — taariikhaha waxaa laga helaa lancy.ch.
r_0248.target_audience: Dadka degan Magaalada Lancy, dadweynaha oo dhan
r_0248.access_conditions: Bilaash, diiwaangelin la'aan. La imow qalabkaaga (qalab lama bixiyo).

r_0249.name: FacLab — UNIGE (Battelle)
r_0249.description: Aqoon-is-weydaarsiga wax-soo-saarka dijitaalka ah ee Jaamacadda Geneva oo u furan dadweynaha, kuna yaal beerta Battelle. Daabacaadda 3D, jarista laysarka, elektaroonigga iyo tababarro ku saabsan farsamooyinka wax-soo-saarka dijitaalka ah, oo ay ku jiraan aqoon-is-weydaarsiyo loogu talagalay dhallinyarada iyo fasallada dugsiyada. Wuxuu soo dhaweeyaa arday, ururro iyo muwaadiniin hawlahiisa dhexdooda.
r_0249.target_audience: Arday, samee-yaal (makers), ururro iyo dadka degan ee xiiseeya wax-soo-saarka dijitaalka ah
r_0249.access_conditions: Diiwaangelin ayaa lagu sameeyaa bulshada internetka ee faclab.ch ama adigoo ka qaybgalaya hawlaha la bixiyo. La xiriir faclab@unige.ch.

r_0250.name: EPER — Adeegyo caawimaad oo wareega
r_0250.description: Goob dhageysi, macluumaad iyo hagid loogu talagalay muhaajiriinta xaalad adag ku nool, gaar ahaan bulshooyinka ku hadla Isbaanishka, Boortaqiiska, Mongooliyaanka iyo Filibiinka. Su'aalo maamul iyo bulsho, taageero hawlaha maamulka, kulamo macluumaad, aqoon-is-weydaarsiyo iyo hawlo isboorti iyo dhaqan.
r_0250.target_audience: Dadka aan haysan sharci degenaansho ama kuwa dhowaan sharci helay (ka baxsan nidaamka magangelyada oo aan haysan baasaboor EU/AELE)
r_0250.access_conditions: Bilaash. La-tashiyo shaqsiyeed ballan ayaa loo qabsadaa; kulamada macluumaadka ballan looma baahna; aqoon-is-weydaarsiyada iyo hawlaha waxaa loo baahan yahay diiwaangelin.

r_0251.name: Espace Léman — xarun dabiici ah oo u heellan harada (ASL)
r_0251.description: Xarunta dabeecadda ee Association pour la Sauvegarde du Léman (ASL), oo ku taal bartamaha Eaux-Vives. Baaritaan bilaash ah oo ku saabsan harada iyo nidaamyadeeda deegaan: indho-indhayn mikroskoob, aqoon-is-weydaarsiyo lagu aqoonsado noocyada, barnaamijyada « Labo Léman » (kalluun, shimbiro, molluska, dhirta biyaha, wasakhda balaastikada), bandhigyo iyo hawlo loogu talagalay dugsiyada laga bilaabo da'da 5 sano.
r_0251.target_audience: Dadweynaha oo dhan: qoysas, dugsiyo, dadka jecel dabeecadda
r_0251.access_conditions: Bilaash sanadka oo dhan, gelitaanku waa furan yahay.

r_0252.name: Autonomia — Adeegga caawimaadda maamulka
r_0252.description: Adeeg caawimaad maamul oo bilaash ah oo aan ballan loo baahnayn: kulan 30 daqiiqo ah oo lala yeesho shaqaale bulsho si aad u eegto xaaladdaada, u fahanto biil, u buuxiso dokumenti, ama u hesho jihayn ku saabsan habraacyada (canshuuraha, AVS, gargaarka bulshada, xuquuqda iyo waajibaadka). Ururku wuxuu sidoo kale bixiyaa aqoon-is-weydaarsiyo waxbarasho maamul iyo la-socod shakhsi ah.
r_0252.target_audience: Dhallinyarada qaangaarka ah iyo qoysaska, qof kasta oo u baahan caawimaad arrimaha maamulka
r_0252.access_conditions: Bilaash, ballan looma baahna. Kulamadu waa 30 daqiiqo, dabaqa 2aad.

r_0253.name: Europe-Charmilles — Adeegga taageerada nafsiga
r_0253.description: Adeeg taageero nafsi oo bilaash ah oo uu bixiyo Ururka Europe-Charmilles, loona talagalay carruurta, dhallinyarada iyo dadka waaweyn. Dhegeysi iyo taageero nafsi oo xaafadda laga helo, in ka badan 100 la-tashi sanadkii. Urur xaafadeed oo loo aqoonsaday inuu dan guud u leeyahay bulshada.
r_0253.access_conditions: Bilaash, ballan ayaa loo baahan yahay.

r_0254.name: Europe-Charmilles — Adeegga talada sharciga
r_0254.description: Adeeg talo sharci oo bilaash ah oo uu bixiyo Ururka Europe-Charmilles: talo iyo jihayn sharci oo xaafadda laga helo, in ka badan 200 la-tashi sanadkii. Wuxuu dhammaystiraa Adeegga Talada Sharciga ee Ardayda (PJE) oo isla cinwaankan ku yaal.
r_0254.target_audience: Dadka deggan xaafadda iyo qof kasta oo u baahan talo sharci
r_0254.access_conditions: Bilaash, ballan ayaa loo baahan yahay.

r_0255.name: Europe-Charmilles — Adeegga taageerada shaqada
r_0255.description: Taageero shaqo oo bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay dadka deggan Charmilles ee da'doodu tahay 16 ilaa 64 sano: CV, waraaqaha codsiga, raadinta shaqo ama tababar, jihaynta xirfadda.
r_0255.target_audience: Dadka deggan xaafadda Charmilles ee da'doodu tahay 16 ilaa 64 sano
r_0255.access_conditions: Bilaash, ballan ayaa loo baahan yahay.

r_0256.name: Europe-Charmilles — Adeegga taageerada bulshada
r_0256.description: Adeeg taageero bulsho oo bilaash ah oo uu bixiyo Ururka Europe-Charmilles: caafimaadka, guriyeynta, gargaarka dhaqaalaha, gargaarka cuntada — dhegeysi, macluumaad iyo jihayn loogu talagalay dadka waaweyn iyo qoysaska xaafadda.
r_0256.access_conditions: Bilaash, ballan ayaa loo baahan yahay.

r_0257.name: Free-Go Espace 99 — Qaboojiyaha wadaagga bulshada
r_0257.description: Qaboojiye is-adeeg ah oo ka tirsan shabakadda Free-Go, kuna yaal Espace 99: qof kastaa wuxuu bilaash ku dhigi karaa ama ka qaadan karaa cunto, si looga hortago khasaaraha cuntada. Waqti kasta waa la heli karaa.
